summary: IBC Section 31(4) mandatory CCI approval timing; prior approval not directory; CIRP cannot proceed without competition clearance; CCI approval must precede CoC approval; procedural non-compliance invalidates resolution plan; AGI Greenpac's delayed CCI application rejection; NCLAT error in treating timeline as directory; divestment condition after CoC approval ineffective.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; NCLAT judgments dated 18.09.2023 and 28.07.2023 set aside; resolution plan approval quashed; CCI approval process must precede CoC approval.
